summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3, adj-ldo): evaluated 37 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 8 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 0 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 8 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=ADJ, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (VOUT).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 10 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 1.25 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (125 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (15 V rec / 20 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
